reports.caption: Figure 1: Coverage, repeatability, and selection on 386 complete MATH tasks. Oracle coverage matches executions, not tokens/calls; headroom uses repeat means. Persistent task counts require at least one generated member to win/lose against baseline in all three repeats; the sole win is extraction-sensitive. Intervals are 95% bootstrap CIs. Program drawings are schematic.
reports.method: PDF composition with original text excerpt; no reflow or LaTeX compilation
